holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit reached ₹16,276 crore in June 2026 quarter from ₹14,456 crore in June 2025.
Anup Bagchi resigned as ICICI Life MD & CEO effective October 13, 2026, with Sidharatha Mishra appointed to take charge on October 14, 2026.
The bank received a GST show cause notice for ₹229.14 crore plus interest and penalty on September 30, 2026.

expected.text: Nomura expects 17% core PPOP growth for the banking sector in Q2.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest holding at 8.97%. Its modest 3-month decline of 3.3% helped buffer steeper losses elsewhere in the 34.9% financials basket.

watch.text: Resolution of the ₹229.14 crore GST tax dispute.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Anup Bagchi was appointed as MD & CEO starting October 27, 2026, for a three-year term.
Provisional advances stood at ₹33,075 billion and deposits reached ₹33,275 billion as of September 2026.
Net profit for the June 2026 quarter came in at ₹20,383 crore compared to ₹17,090 crore in June 2025.
Foreign institutional investors trimmed their stake by 2.4% during the September quarter.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding an 8.57% allocation, HDFC Bank's 14.27% 3-month decline contributed an estimated -1.223 percentage points to fund performance, making it the single largest performance detractor.

watch.text: Leadership transition to incoming MD & CEO Anup Bagchi on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 quarter revenue stood at ₹309,468 crore with net profit of ₹23,196 crore.
The company allotted ₹13,008.6 crore in 7.90% unsecured NCDs maturing in October 2036.
Customs issued an order imposing a ₹18.75 lakh fine and penalty, which the company intends to appeal.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 5.15% fund weight, the stock fell 10.51% over 3 months, generating an estimated -0.541 percentage point drag on portfolio return.

watch.text: Potential market listing steps and valuation announcements for Jio Platforms.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue rose to ₹58,539 crore with net profit touching ₹10,012 crore in the June 2026 quarter.
Airtel rolled out refreshed postpaid plans featuring complimentary international roaming from October 8, 2026.
Airtel Business unveiled IQ Gateway, a DPDP-compliant enterprise platform spanning messaging, WhatsApp, and voice.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 5.06% portfolio weight, Bharti Airtel's 6.0% 3-month decline produced an estimated -0.304 percentage point impact on fund return.

watch.text: Subscriber response and ARPU changes following postpaid plan adjustments.

holdings.name: Infosys Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 quarter net profit stood at ₹7,775 crore on sales of ₹48,211 crore.
The company deepened its collaboration with ABN AMRO for AI transformation via Infosys Topaz, and partnered with Columbia University for an enterprise AI center.
The United States government suspended PERM processing under its green card programme for major Indian IT firms including Infosys.

holdings.why_it_matters: Infosys holds a 3.93% weight in the portfolio. The stock has dropped 20.82% over 6 months and 32.19% over 1 year, dampening Technology sector performance.

watch.text: Operational adjustments and talent mobility impacts stemming from US PERM suspensions.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Provisional figures for September 30, 2026 showed gross advances at ₹13,846 billion and deposits at ₹14,521 billion.
Net profit climbed to ₹7,670 crore in the June 2026 quarter, compared to ₹6,279 crore in June 2025.
Senior management official Sanjeev Moghe submitted his resignation, effective October 30, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Axis Bank accounts for 3.71% of fund assets. Despite a 4.88% dip over 3 months, it posted a 1.66% gain over the past month.

watch.text: Deposit growth trajectory following the ₹14.5 lakh crore Q2 milestone.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T bagged an LNTP for a 2x800 MW thermal power plant in Chandrapura and mega EPC orders across Saudi Arabia, UAE, and India.
Sales reached ₹67,942 crore with net profit of ₹4,988 crore for the quarter ended June 2026.
The long-stop date for selling its equity stake in L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad was pushed to December 31, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: L&T represents 3.5% of fund assets and forms the cornerstone of its 8.7% Industrials allocation. It declined 6.15% over the trailing 3 months.

watch.text: Execution milestones and financial closure on the Hyderabad Metro disinvestment before December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: June 2026 quarterly profit before tax reached ₹32,884 crore with net profit of ₹25,121 crore on revenue of ₹136,240 crore.
The bank purchased approximately 40% of Reliance Industries' $1.35 billion debt offering.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.18% weight, SBI fell 7.42% in the last 3 months, aligning with broader consolidation across the fund's 34.9% financials exposure.

watch.text: Core credit demand trends following participation in large corporate debt issuances.

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: Vehicle sales rose 15% year-on-year in September 2026 to exceed 1.14 lakh units, while monthly production totaled 121,722 units.
Embraer entered an agreement to purchase 51% of Novavayu Aerospace for roughly ₹5.1 lakh by December 1, 2026.
Net profit for the June 2026 quarter reached ₹5,998 crore on revenue of ₹58,188 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.06% position, M&M's 10.65% drop over 3 months contributed an estimated -0.326 percentage points to the fund's return.

watch.text: Regulatory clearance from CCI on Lightrock Group's proposed investment in Mahindra Last Mile Mobility.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Quarterly sales climbed to ₹20,211 crore in June 2026 from ₹7,167 crore in June 2025, with operating profit expanding to ₹594 crore.
The company onboarded 3.1 lakh delivery partners across Zomato and Blinkit during FY26.
CBIC issued clarification concerning a 5% GST levy on food and ride hailing platforms.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.72% allocation, Zomato surged 11.67% over 3 months, generating an estimated +0.317 percentage point return contribution and serving as the fund's second-biggest positive contributor.

watch.text: Margin impact following clarified 5% GST implementation on platform orders.

portfolio.statement: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund lost 6.05% over the past 3 months, weighed down by heavy banking and energy exposures.
interp: Concentrated large-cap drag: Top portfolio weights HDFC Bank (-14.27%) and Reliance Industries (-10.51%) together generated an estimated -1.764 percentage point loss.
New-age consumer resilience: Positive contributions from One 97 Communications (+0.414 pts) and Zomato (+0.317 pts) offered partial insulation against cyclical large-cap drawdowns.
portfolio.line: Slumping index leaders in financials and energy outweighed positive momentum in new-economy holdings.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank declined 14.27% over 3 months amid a 2.4% stake reduction by foreign institutional investors in Q2.
Zomato supported returns with an 11.67% 3-month rise on the back of June 2026 revenues growing to ₹20,211 crore.

themes.title: Private Banking Dominance
themes.text: The fund maintains 34.9% exposure to financials, centered heavily in large private lenders where credit expansion continues alongside leadership handovers.

themes.title: Platform Scaling
themes.text: High-growth digital consumer networks delivered capital appreciation, counterbalancing legacy mature technology holdings.

macro.why: PERM processing suspensions under the US green card framework present compliance and workforce deployment headwinds for Indian software exporters.
Large banks reported sustained loan book expansion in Q2, with advances crossing ₹33 lakh crore at HDFC Bank and ₹13.8 lakh crore at Axis Bank.

priced_in.text: Strong loan expansion across private lenders, reflected in Q2 business updates showing advances of ₹33,075 billion at HDFC Bank and ₹13,846 billion at Axis Bank.

could_change.title: Jio Platforms Listing Dynamics
could_change.text: Valuation discovery and potential IPO plans for Jio Platforms could re-rate Reliance Industries' core market valuation.

could_change.title: Platform Tax Realignment
could_change.text: Implementation details of the clarified 5% GST levy on consumer aggregator apps could influence take rates at Zomato.

portfolio.risk_note: With 47.8% of capital in top 10 positions and 34.9% in Financials, fund returns remain acutely vulnerable to drawdowns in premier banking names.
